test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Name the country that has officially proclaimed 'Gross National Happiness (GNH)' as the measure of its progress.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhutan**__.

__
 
• **Gross national happiness was first coined in 1972 by the fourth King of Bhutan, King Jigme Singye Wangchuck**__.

 __
 
• The concept implies that sustainable development should take a holistic approach to notions of progress and give equal importance to the non-economic aspects of well-being.
 
• The Gross National Happiness Index, Bhutan sought to create a measurement tool that would be useful for policymaking and to create policy incentives for the government, NGOs and businesses in Bhutan to increase GNH.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The GNH measure has been designed to include nine core domains that are regarded as components of happiness in Bhutan and are constructed of indicators that are robust and informative with respect to each of the domains.
 
• The nine domains are:
 
 
• Psychological well being.
 
• Health.
 
• Time use.
 
• Education.
 
• Cultural diversity and resilience.
 
• Good Governance.
 
• Community vitality.
 
• Ecological diversity and resilience.
 
• Living standard.
